resources.string: Turn text, websites, or social media links into QR codes instantly. QRKod makes it simple to generate QR codes for anything you want to share.
Create QR codes for websites, LinkedIn, Twitter, and other social profiles. Perfect for sharing your contact details, portfolio, or online presence.
Download your QR codes to your device or share them directly via WhatsApp, SMS, email, and other apps in just a tap.
